input.content:
import rdflib
g = rdflib.Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")

# Which students currently enrolled in each course
q = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?course (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?n) WHERE {
  ?s uni:isEnrolledIn ?course ; uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?ed .
  OPTIONAL { ?s uni:hasGraduationDate ?gd }
  FILTER(!BOUND(?gd) || ?gd > "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
} GROUP BY ?course ORDER BY ?course
"""
print("Currently-enrolled per course:")
for r in g.query(q):
    print(" ", r.course.split("/")[-1], int(r.n))

# Per department currently-enrolled distinct students
q2 = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?dept (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?n) WHERE {
  ?course uni:isTaughtIn ?dept .
  ?s uni:isEnrolledIn ?course ; uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?ed .
  OPTIONAL { ?s uni:hasGraduationDate ?gd }
  FILTER(!BOUND(?gd) || ?gd > "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
} GROUP BY ?dept ORDER BY ?dept
"""
print("\nCurrently-enrolled per department:")
for r in g.query(q2):
    print(" ", r.dept.split("/")[-1], int(r.n))
